caseNameFull: Cantor, dba Selden Drugs Co. v. Detroit Edison Co.

opinions.text: C. A. 6th Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 821.] Motion of the Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae in support of petitioner granted and 15 additional minutes allotted for that purpose. Respondent allotted 15 additional minutes for oral argument.
